qf.primerHtml: Thirteen channels, one story. Wrong Side of Town and the Reno holographic swamp — Americas, Alaska to Tierra del Fuego. Puerto Reno · 24x365.
qf.tagline: Thirteen channels. One story. You can land in the lyrics: shout-out, whole track, or a nine-song run for your city.
qf.heroAmericasHtml: Wrong Side of Town and the Reno holographic swamp are music from the wrong side of town in the Americas - from the North Slope of Alaska to Tierra del Fuego - celebrating, metabolizing, and crystallizing their beats, vibes, languages, and perreo.
qf.btnTalkCheap: Talk is cheap — see the Hood (Snap)

qf.ledePocketHtml: We are not here to drown you in pages. Listen first. If the frequency hits, step to the casting call below or tip on the rails - Fair Exchange, you and the Captain, no suit in the middle.
qf.ledeCastingHtml: Wrong Side of Town: The Musical is booking cast, not crowd filler. Subject line on every email: ACTIVATE THE WRONG SIDE OF TOWN: THE MUSICAL - in the body, say which lane you are reading for (shout-out, lead track, or nine-song city run).
qf.offer100Body: A named beat in the mix, voiced on the record - you are credited in the Wrong Side story, not wallpaper.
qf.offer1kBody: Your song, you center frame - written and produced here, golden-ratio mix discipline, built to open on the feed.
qf.offer10kBody: A full run for your town or your movement - cast the place in nine tracks, Sovereign Node energy.
qf.ledePassesHtml: Festival passes (GA, day, Bachstage, Golden) run on the same Fair Exchange rails. Email ACTIVATE / QUESTFEST or use the apps below.
qf.h2StudioHtml: The holographic AI behind Wrong Side of Town: The Musical is not just theory
qf.ledeStudio1Html: The show runs on phones and speakers you already own - but underneath it is a real awareness OS metaphor: honest boundaries, phi-locked structure, and thirteen channels that stay in sync with something you can inspect, not a black-box feed that vanishes when the tour leaves town.
qf.ledeStudio2Html: On this site the public stack entry is Under the Hood · Juicy Juicy - Snap Omniversal Fractal Compiler (OFC) — prompt in, Snap compile, two artifacts out. Bench truth and the runnable API still live in FractiAI/digital-pru on GitHub. The long technical archive reader (older naming) is deprecated but kept for deep links.
qf.ledeStudio3Html: That changes the game for cast and listeners: big stages sell trust us. This stack says show the pipe - ride Under the Hood, clone the repo, run the tests. Fair Exchange stops being a slogan and becomes verifiable rhythm between story, silicon, and the street.

hood.h1: Talk is cheap. Open the hood.
hood.ampHtml: Talk is cheap. Under the Hood is Juicy Juicy - Snap Omniversal Fractal Compiler (OFC) on this site — the part you can compile and copy, not just the poster story.
hood.heroHtml: Big festivals run on big talk. This legacy catalog puts the master canon (DNA / PEFF) up top, then Juicy Juicy Snap on the Hood for the live compile surface. To run APIs and labs, use FractiAI/digital-pru on GitHub. The nested list below is optional backup only.
hood.plainTitle: What you are actually looking at
hood.plainIntro: Anyone can say their stack is holographic or awareness-grade. This lane backs up what you already saw on Juicy Juicy Snap (OFC): honest compile rules, optional long papers, and GitHub for anything you need to run locally.
hood.pass1h: Snap is the part you can kick
hood.pass1p: On the Hood OFC page, a compile either emits two JSON artifacts or aborts on safety tokens — that is the shallow proof. Deeper RTL and tests still live in the digital-pru repo; this catalog is for readers who want the long narrative stack.
hood.pass2h: Start with the master canon, then Juicy Juicy Snap
hood.pass2p: Open the master canon first (DNA / PEFF, Part I + II). Then Juicy Juicy - Snap OFC on the Hood for the compile window. Want to interact with APIs and labs? Go to FractiAI/digital-pru. The technical archive reader is optional history.
hood.pass3h: The nested list is optional backup
hood.pass3p: Everything under Optional backup is ordered from outer PEFF thesis shell down to studio notes. You never need those files to get the point. They back up the master canon when you want a single-topic long read.
hood.mainCanonHead: Main paper - Digital Pru / DNA transformer / PEFF
hood.mainCanonSub: Read this first. One merged master canon (Part I: PEFF / Omnizoan / infill 13, Part II: helical bio-electromagnetics). Everything below is optional backup, ordered from outer thesis shell down to studio notes.
hood.mainCanonTitle: Digital Pru / DNA Transformer / PEFF - master canon
hood.mainCanonBlurb: Full stack narrative in one file: outer PEFF operating-system language, then inner DNA transformer physics and EGS hooks. Split editions remain for smaller downloads.
hood.papersHead: Extra documents (only if you want them)
hood.papersSub: Talk is cheap. If you already ran Juicy Juicy Snap on the Hood, you have the public heart of it. Tap below only for longer files — or use digital-pru on GitHub to run the stack.
hood.papersSubNested: These channels back up the master canon and Juicy Juicy Snap (Hood). None are required to operate the stack on GitHub.
